description: This Java class provides utility functions for testing CBOR serialization and conversion to hex strings, including methods for serializing JsonValue objects with Jackson CBOR factory and converting byte buffers to byte arrays or hex strings.

classes.name: CborTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to serialize JsonValue objects to CBOR byte arrays and hex strings, mainly used for testing purposes.

methods.name: serializeWithJackson
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue to a CBOR byte array using Jackson CBOR factory, returning the raw bytes.

methods.name: serializeToHexString
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to a CBOR-encoded hex string for easier comparison or display.

methods.name: sizedByteArrayFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Converts the remaining content of a ByteBuffer into a byte array of appropriate size.
